notes: Modern EOS seasons now launch with the D3D11 shader path, so Chapter 4+ builds reach EOS login and the lobby instead of stopping at MissingRequiredShadersError. If a modern build cannot start Magnesium's optional local host, VAULTED still launches the player client instead of failing the whole launch.
